name: SBS On Demand for Android TV

sources.label: Morphe patches for SBS On Demand on Android TV
sources.author: Supperelias2 SBS TV
patch_list: Prevents the Play licensing redirect when launching a sideloaded SBS TV build.
Prefers an available Akamai live stream over Google DAI. Broadcast ads remain. Keeps original selection when no direct stream is available.
Prefers an available Akamai VOD stream over Google DAI. Keeps original selection for live or missing alternatives. Ad removal is not guaranteed.
Checks SBS TV 6.3.1 playback integration points. Does not remove advertisements.
